articles.summary: Requesting Your DNS Access To get your website up and running, we would like to request access to your domain name server or DNS. If your site is hosted on GoDaddy, we have two options of doing this. 1. Please give us delegated access. Here is how to ...
articles.answer:
Requesting Your DNS Access



To get your website up and running, we would like to request access to your domain name server or DNS.

If your site is hosted on GoDaddy, we have two options of doing this.

1. Please give us delegated access. Here is how to do that: https://www.godaddy.com/help/invite-a-delegate-to-access-my-godaddy-account-12376  
Please use the email helpdesk@webriq.us

In case you are on another domain server (not GoDaddy), please provide us your login details or a way to access your DNS similar to having a delegated access in GoDaddy.

Once we have access or login details, we will process the rest for you to get your website live.
2. If you aren't comfortable giving us delegated access or your login details, you will need to do part of the process to go live on your end. To do this, please follow these steps:

a. Go to your DNS Settings and go to the Nameservers section. It looks like this if you are on GoDaddy:
 
b. Click the "Change" button.
c. On the pull-down menu please click on "Custom".
d. Change the nameservers to the following:
nameserver 1: adrian.ns.cloudflare.com
nameserver 2: buck.ns.cloudflare.com
e. Please inform us when this is completed and we will do the rest of the process on our end.

Please rest assured that nothing will happen to your current website even after changing the nameservers. The new website will only go live after you have given us your go signal.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach us via the Helpdesk -helpdesk@webriq.us.

We are as excited as you to get your website up and running!

Thank you,

articles.title: Setting Website Live
articles.summary: 1. Take a screenshot of the current DNS settings on Cloudflare and save it (in case it needs to be reset to the previous settings) e.g   2. you have 3 A records and a bunch of cname records The end result is always for us to replace all existing A ...
articles.answer:
1. Take a screenshot of the current DNS settings on Cloudflare and save it (in case it needs to be reset to the previous settings)
e.g
 

2. you have 3 A records and a bunch of cname records
The end result is always for us to replace all existing A records with one A record pointing to our IP ADDESS.
The only relevant A record is the one with name @ or in this case jjgates.com -- let's change that first to our IP address 104.198.14.52


now delete the other two A records

3. Now you need to add a CNAME record with name www -- most settings have already a CNAME record with that name, just go and find it and replace the existing content with jjgates.netlify.app (always use netlify.app) -- in case there is no CNAME record with www you need to add that record



4. Now log in to WebriQ APP and go to jjgates settings

in the domain settings -- you always need to have a webriq.me subdomain that is primary, a naked domain, i.e. jjgates.com and a www domain, i.e. www.jjgates.com
so next to jjgates.com you see an edit button, click on it, you will see a pop up window and a check box to set this domain to primary


You need to change the primary domain to the naked domain, always!!!!!


then click on update site at the left bottom

FYI - it could take a bit of time before the DNS changes are propagated, so no worries if you see the old site up for another couple of hours. Check back once in a while.

5. Last thing to do - is delete the domain jjgates.webriq.me on the WebriQ APP. You will need to ask Jun on Monday how you have to do that. But it needs to be done in all cases.

_________________________________
SEND TO CLIENT

We have set the website live. It could take a bit of time before the DNS changes are propagated, so please do not be alarmed if you still see the old site up, or it shows "not secure" for another couple of hours. Depending on your host, it could take from just a few minutes to as long as 48 hours. 

Now that your website is live, to make sure you are ready for the second phase of our services, please schedule a quick call with Alex Belding at https://webriq.zohobookings.com/#/customer/customer-care.


Thank you,

articles.title: Invoicing Portal and Payments
articles.summary: Home The Home or Dashboard is the first screen that you will see when you log in to the portal. It gives an overview of the transactions. You can view the following details on the dashboard: Outstanding Invoices: The total amount of any unpaid ...
articles.answer:
Home

The Home or Dashboard is the first screen that you will see when you log in to the portal. It gives an overview of the transactions. You can view the following details on the dashboard:

  • Outstanding Invoices: The total amount of any unpaid invoice will be shown. You can click Pay Now to pay the entire amount.

  • Available Credits: The total amount of your remaining credits, which are obtained if there have been refunds or if credit notes were created. 

  • Available Retainer Payments: The total retainer amount available that you can refund or apply to your invoices.

  • Last Payment Made: The amount and date of the recent payment done.

Apart from the above details, the home page also displays your account details and your organization’s contact details.

Transactions

You can view the status of all the invoices you have received, as well as the payments made in the past.

Invoices

Here you can view the list of invoices you have received. If the invoice is unpaid, you can choose to pay instantly by clicking Pay Now. You can also filter the list to display a particular type of invoice by clicking the drop-down above the list

Feel free to forward the invoice to an email address and also download the invoice in the form of PDF or print the invoice by clicking the more icon on the top right corner and selecting the respective options.

If you have any remarks and would like to discuss that with us, then you can use the comments box to add queries or notes as comments. You will be able to view our replies here as well and have an official record of the conversation.

You can make payments by choosing a mode of payment. We have a variety of payment gateway options for your convenience.

Card Payments

For making payments using Credit/Debit card, you can enter your card number, CVV, expiry date, billing address, and your country to make payment. You can also save the cards and use them while making payments for upcoming invoices.

Account Payments

If you choose this option, simply fill in the details required.

You can also choose to save your account details for future transactions by checking the Use this account for future transactions option.

Payments Made

In the Payments Made module, you will be able to view the payments you have made to your invoices. You can also list the payments based on invoice payments and retainer invoice payments and sort them based on the date and amount.

The receipts can be downloaded as PDFs by clicking the Download PDF button and can be printed by clicking the Print button on the top.

Statements

You can view a detailed Statement of Accounts consisting of all the transactions. You can also have the statements printed or downloaded as PDFs.

Client Details

  • Update Account Details

  • Edit Card Details

  • Change Password

Update Account Details

If you wish to change your personal or company details, you can update them easily. Here’s how:

  • Go to the Home page.

  • Scroll down to My Account Details and click the pencil icon.

  • Fill in the details and click Save.

You can also change your address by clicking the pencil icon next to the address box.

Edit Card Details

You can edit your card details at any time. Here’s how:

  • Go to the Home page.

  • Scroll down to the Card Details section and click Edit next to the card whose details you want to change.

  • Fill in the details and click Save.

Change Password

To safeguard your transactions, you can regularly change your account password. Here’s how:

  • Click Change Password in the left sidebar.

  • Enter the Old Password and enter a New Password that satisfies the password requirements.

  • Re-enter the password to confirm and click Save.

Other Actions

  • Send Email

  • Write Review

  • Logout

Send Email

You can contact us directly from the portal by sending an email. Here’s how:

  • Go to the Home page.

  • At the bottom of the page, our business details will be mentioned.

  • Click the Send Email button and enter the Subject and Message.

  • Click Send.

Write Review

Your satisfaction with our services is important to us so any feedback is welcome. Please feel free to write us a review. Here’s how:

  • Go to the Home page.

  • At the bottom of the page, you will see our business details.

  • Click the Review button.

  • Enter a message and click Submit Review.

 

Logout

To logout from the portal, you can click Logout from the left sidebar.

articles.title: How to Join WebriQ Cliq Channel
articles.summary: Join WebriQ Cliq Channel Good day, we are moving from Slack to Zoho Cliq! We will be sending you an invite to join our WebriQ Cliq Channel for free. You can download the app here https://www.zoho.com/cliq/desktop/windows.html. Zoho Cliq is also ...
articles.answer:
Join WebriQ Cliq Channel


Good day, we are moving from Slack to Zoho Cliq! We will be sending you an invite to join our WebriQ Cliq Channel for free. You can download the app here https://www.zoho.com/cliq/desktop/windows.html. Zoho Cliq is also available on both Google Store and Apple Store for mobile use.


Below is a guide and sample screenshots how to accept the invitation:


1. Once you receive the invitation, please click the Sign up for Cliq button. If you are already a Cliq user, you can proceed to step #5.


2. If you are a non-Cliq user, you will receive a channel invite via email along with a call to action 'Sign up for Cliq'. Please confirm your account and verify your email.


3. To get started you can either 'Join an existing company' or 'Create your own company'. To create your own company simply click the button.


4. Enter your company name and click the Create button. Please click the invitation link again (step #1) to proceed with joining the channel.


5. You will then be directed to this page. Just click the Join this channel button to finish.

If you have questions please feel free to ask us at helpdesk@webriq.us.



Thank you,
